image_description: A close-up, front-facing view of a vintage aneroid barometer. The instrument features a dark, polished wooden casing with a distinctively shaped, slightly squared-off circular profile. The central dial is brass or gold-toned with black numerical markings and a pointer hand. To the left of the main dial, there is a smaller vertical thermometer attached to the casing. The background is a plain, light-colored wall.
